WITH stage_0 AS (
  SELECT * FROM __nano_lake_source__
  WHERE time >= '2026-09-24 07:00:00.000000' AND time < '2026-09-25 07:01:00.000000'
  AND ((((hasAllTokens(lower(message), '14e0857b37f6c5e5e90bab786a4db8fceb4166afe75e617519d942656976481e') OR hasAllTokens(lower(raw_data), '14e0857b37f6c5e5e90bab786a4db8fceb4166afe75e617519d942656976481e'))) AND lower("metadata.log_source") != 'audit'))
),
stage_1 AS (
  SELECT * FROM stage_0
  ORDER BY time DESC, "metadata.uid" DESC
  LIMIT 100
)
SELECT time, "device.hostname", class_uid FROM stage_1 ORDER BY time DESC, "metadata.uid" DESC LIMIT 100 SETTINGS max_threads=16, max_execution_time=300, optimize_read_in_order=1, optimize_aggregation_in_order=1
